# Cross Designs

> A one-person South Florida web studio run by Aiden Camacho (Cross), based in Kendall. Custom hand-built websites, website revamps, and local SEO for small and local businesses, with managed ads (Google and Meta) available for established clients. One person builds the site, revamps the old one, and ranks it on Google, so clients deal with a single point of contact instead of three separate freelancers. Available to clients nationwide.

## Services and rates
- Web design (https://crossdesigned.com/services/web-design/): custom, mobile-first small business sites. $1,500 flat, quoted up front, live in about a week. A $0-down plan gets the same build at $150 a month on a 12-month term, with the site fully owned by the client at the end of the term.
- Website revamp / redesign (https://crossdesigned.com/services/website-redesign/): rebuilds that keep the domain and rankings and replace the dated template. Same $1,500 flat price as new builds, and the $0-down plan applies here too.
- Local SEO (https://crossdesigned.com/services/local-seo/): service pages, area pages, schema markup, Google Business Profile alignment, honest reporting. $300 a month with site maintenance and any changes included. On qualifying sites, a performance option replaces the monthly: no fee and 10% of tracked sales generated by the site, with tracking agreed up front.
- Google Business Profile optimization (https://crossdesigned.com/services/google-business-profile/): full profile build-out, posts, and an honest review system.
- Google Ads management (https://crossdesigned.com/services/google-ads/): search campaigns with flat management fees, quoted around the client's budget.
- Meta Ads management (https://crossdesigned.com/services/meta-ads/): Facebook and Instagram campaigns with creative designed in-house.
- Free website review: any business can submit its current site on the homepage (https://crossdesigned.com/#free-review) and get back an honest teardown of what is costing it leads, at no charge.
